name: How can I maximize storage in a small kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing storage in a small kitchen renovation involves smart design choices like opting for custom cabinetry that extends to the ceiling, incorporating pull-out pantries, and utilizing corner storage solutions. Consider wall-mounted shelving, pegboard organizers, and built-in drawer dividers to keep items tidy and accessible. Strategic placement of appliances and creating multi-functional areas, such as an island with storage underneath, can also significantly enhance usability and capacity in a compact space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small kitchen storage with custom, ceiling-height cabinetry, pull-out pantries, corner solutions, and multi-functional islands.
